title: Separate finite Cartier and trace arrow equations
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring object, A an ordinary commutative ring, Y a scheme with P=ProjectiveLine Y and W=diagonalSurface Y, L a family of internal R-module lines, and d a Diagram [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Give finite realizations eY,eP,eW [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. For N killing A and specified positive finite line isomorphisms [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line], define two predicates by actual equalities, with no existential witnesses. FiniteCartierArrowEquation, with A finite, Y Noetherian, N positive and invertible on W, takes a supported-source isomorphism and asserts that the source-conjugated image of d.delta through the exact single/shift comparisons and the supplied lineW equals finiteCartierArrow. FiniteProjectiveTraceEquation takes a finite q_* right-derived model Rq, its equality with geoP1Pushforward, a FinitePushSquare, and a splitting of the positive finite line shifted by two plus constant unit. It asserts that eY(d.traceq) followed by its derived unit equals the square comparison followed by Rq of the shifted lineP comparison, transport through the model equality and geoP1Trace. These are precisely the two equality clauses of FiniteDiagonalComparison [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-diagonal], with all models and endpoint maps supplied. Neither predicate changes an object or chooses data. For finite A, FiniteTracePresentation stores a supplied right-derived q_* model, its equality with the canonical pushforward, full cochain-unit normalization, FinitePushSquare, positive splitting and the equality of its hom with geoP1TwistedMap. These are exactly the data already appearing in FiniteDiagonalComparison, without an assertion of existence. FinitePresentedTraceEquation is exactly FiniteProjectiveTraceEquation evaluated on the fields of a supplied FiniteTracePresentation and its supplied line isomorphism. It makes no additional assertion and keeps these projections at generic coefficients.

def FiniteCartierArrowEquation [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X) (d : Diagram R Y L)
    (eW : FiniteRealization R A (diagonalSurface Y))
    (lineW : eW.F.obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (diagonalSurface Y))
    (sourceIso : eW.F.obj (source R Y) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
        (geoCartierConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y))) : Prop
